### `async readLegacyRecordOwned(sandbox, key, { budget = null, category = 'clean', fallbackEnvelopeBytes, maxDecodedAllocationBytes, overheadBytes = 8192, assertCurrent = ()`

Admit the complete legacy GCM/JSON value before IDB and object parsing. Native GCM remains whole-record; the returned owner covers source plus one consumer snapshot until release. Unknown budget capabilities keep old caps.
